question: When did the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) organise the Startup India Innovation Week 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 January 2024 to 18 January 2024**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to available information, t**he Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT**) organised the Startup India Innovation Week 2024 from J**anuary 10th to 18th, 2024. **
 
• During the Innovation Week 2024, Secretary,** DPIIT, Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh delivered **the inaugural address in the Startup Seminar: ‘
 
• The event **aimed to promote innovation** and entrepreneurship in India by fostering a supportive ecosystem for startups.
 
• The **Theme was **"Innovation for Transformation."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** About the Department for promotion of Industry & Internal Trade:

 
• ​It is a central government department under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• It was established in the year 1995.
 
• The department was earlier called the Department of Industrial Policy & Promotion and was renamed as DPIIT in January 2019.
 
• The role of DPIIT is to promote/accelerate industrial development of the country by facilitating investment in new and upcoming technology, foreign direct investment, and support the balanced development of industries.
